items.title: 💭 Anthropic Is Bleeding Out
items.content_html:
Here’s my thought on Anthropic Is Bleeding Out

Ah… so things are rough on the business side according to Edward Zitron

An intere|ing note is that anthropic models make more more than half of all token related to programming through OpenRouter… so they clearly have marketshare but if they’re losing money on every single customer then oof… what does the future of vibe coding look like? And who can afford it?

Note

This is one of [[ my-thoughts ]]. I picked this up from Waylon Walker(https://thoughts.waylonwalker.com). It’s a short note that I make about someone else’s content online. Learn more about the process Thoughts
